messages:
rachel: Heads up — CI flagged a Docusaurus build error on the last docs deploy. The reporter shows a broken anchor during static export.

ben: Do we have the raw error?

rachel: From the build log: "MissingFragmentError: unable to resolve fragment '' in page /reference/sdk" — looks like an empty slug.

kai: Empty slugs usually come from odd frontmatter titles or MDX JSX snippets that render as headings. Any recent PRs touching /reference/sdk?

rachel: PR #3094 touched that page to add a language example. The page has an MDX snippet and a frontmatter title containing emoji and zero-width joiners. Example frontmatter: `title: "SDK — JavaScript \u200d✨"` 

ben: Zero-width chars can break slugify. Docusaurus slugifier strips non-alphanumerics but ZWJ sequences sometimes normalize to empty.

kai: Quick test — strip the ZWJ and emoji from the title, or add `slug: sdk-js` in frontmatter as a stable fix.

rachel: Pushed a tiny patch to PR #3094 adding `slug: reference-sdk-js` to frontmatter and updated the example heading to `### JavaScript SDK example`.

docs-bot: @rachel updated PR #3094 10: added frontmatter slug and heading tweak — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3094

deploy-bot: docs CI started for PR #3094 (mkdocs/docusaurus multi-build)

deploy-bot: Docusaurus build 44D succeeded for PR #3094

ben: Nice. Do we want a short guidance in CONTRIBUTING.md about avoiding invisible chars in titles? We keep bumping into unicode edge cases.

kai: Yes, and maybe add a linter that flags zero-width/not-printing codepoints in frontmatter titles. Could be a small node script run in docs CI.

rachel: I'll add a CONTRIBUTING blurb and open an issue for a frontmatter sanitizer. Also adding a one-off test during CI to ensure every page has a non-empty slug after slugify.

docs-bot: @rachel opened issue #116: "docs: flag zero-width char titles + frontmatter slug sanitizer"

ben: Thanks all. Merging PR and promoting to staging now.

rachel: Live on staging: https://staging.docs.redwood.example/reference/sdk.html — anchor renders and deep links work.

kai: Great catch. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
